purpose: Provide an executable validator for finite-rank Q,u,d,L,e,N,H sector projection maps once rho_E transition data are supplied.

supported_format_v1.mesh_N: positive integer subdivision parameter for the closed cell {0,...,N}^6
supported_format_v1.generator_data: same constant or table-valued g1..g6 format accepted by the rho_E mesh validator
supported_format_v1.sector_projection_maps: Q,u,d,L,e,N,H entries, each with kind, dimension, and a 3x3 projector
supported_format_v1.family_sector_dimensions: Q,u,d,L,e,N must have kind family and dimension 3
supported_format_v1.higgs_sector_dimension: H must have kind single_higgs_carrier and dimension 1
supported_format_v1.rho_invariance_equation: rho_E(gamma,z) P_sector = P_sector rho_E(gamma,z) on visited boundary targets

script_exit_codes.0: complete rho_E plus sector-projector candidate passes implemented checks
script_exit_codes.1: complete candidate fails an implemented algebraic or invariance check
script_exit_codes.2: candidate is incomplete/open, such as null generators, missing mesh_N, or missing sector_projection_maps entries

verdict.next_step: Fill selected rho_E, metric, and sector map data from a typed monad/Cech/HYM source, then validate sector-specific D_E actions and assemble Gram, stiffness, and overlap matrices.
